name: 6485-specdecode-k3-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf as the target, JackFram/llama-160m as the draft model
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the draft runs inside the same worker at the same TP (`speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size` is unset).
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 32 KV heads (no GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 32000, window 4096, fp16, 6.7B params (~13.5 GB). Draft: LlamaForCausalLM, 12 layers, hidden 768, 12 heads, intermediate 3072, vocab 32000, window 2048, ~162M params, served in the target's fp16.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 800 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt exactly 512 tokens and output exactly 256, min = max on both; the backend sets `ignore_eos=True` when `max_tokens` is set, so every request generates exactly 256 tokens. n = 1, no best_of, no beam search.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant with a small draft model, answering 512-token prompts with 256-token replies across sixteen concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Serve configuration: draft-model speculative decoding at k=3 on one H100.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
speculative-model: JackFram/llama-160m
num-speculative-tokens: 3

# REQUIRED, not a preference: this engine refuses to start speculative decoding on the V1
# block manager. The draft and target vocabularies must match (32000 on both) or the engine
# refuses the pair outright.
use-v2-block-manager: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
